say:1:1322134001:1.text: Bless Dura, thank you all! I really thought I was going to die here.
say:1:1322134001:1.source_cn: 艾雅保佑，谢谢你们！刚才……刚才我一度真的以为我要死在...

choice_prompt:2:1322134001.text: Bless Dura, thank you all! I really thought I was going to die here.
choice_prompt:2:1322134001.source_cn: 艾雅保佑，谢谢你们！刚才……刚才我一度真的以为我要死在这里了。

say:3:1322134002:1.text: We were all injured and couldn't hold out much longer... Luckily, you came.
say:3:1322134002:1.source_cn: 我们都受了伤，快要撑不住了……还好你们赶来了。

say:5:1322134004:1.text: Our injuries aren't too serious... That... that talking Graveborn showed up just in time. Goddess, I must be losing my mind. How could an undead have saved us?!
say:5:1322134004:1.source_cn: 伤得不算太重……那个，那个……那个会讲话的活死人……来...

say:7:1322134005:1.text: Dura above, I can't believe it... But indeed, it's what happened...
say:7:1322134005:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我也不敢相信，但……事实的确如此，刚才大家都...

say:9:1322134006:1.text: The Graveborn you just encountered is Igor. He might look unusual, but he's a gentle soul with a heart as innocent as a child's.
say:9:1322134006:1.source_cn: 刚才那位亡灵名叫伊戈尔，他虽然相貌怪异，但是位很有童心...

say:11:1322134007:1.text: Yes, and Carolina isn't a bad person either. Even as a Graveborn, she's just as kind as she was in life and not as frightening as you might think!
say:11:1322134007:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜也不是坏人。他们虽然已经成为了亡灵，但依旧和生...

choice_prompt:12:1322134007.text: Yes, and Carolina isn't a bad person either. Even as a Graveborn, she's just as kind as she was in life and not as frightening as you might think!
choice_prompt:12:1322134007.source_cn: 卡列琳娜也不是坏人。他们虽然已经成为了亡灵，但依旧和生前一样善良，并没有你们想象得那样恐怖！

say:14:1322134008:1.text: Yeah, Graveborn, like Igor and Carolina, are nothing like the crazy undead around here!
say:14:1322134008:1.source_cn: 更何况，伊戈尔和卡列琳娜这样的亡灵与那些活死人一点都不一样！

say:16:1322134009:1.text: Most of the undead here have gone mad, but Carolina and Igor, like us, can think clearly and feel emotions.
say:16:1322134009:1.source_cn: 活死人已经没有理智了，但卡列琳娜、伊戈尔他们和我们大家...

say:17:1322134010:1.text: I-I don't really understand, but, Dura above, they're definitely different from the other undead. I've never seen Graveborn like them before.
say:17:1322134010:1.source_cn: 我……我不明白，艾雅在上，但他们的确和活死人不同。我以...

say:20:1322134011:1.text: Lady Carolina, please allow us to apologize for our earlier behavior and to thank you...
say:20:1322134011:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜女士，请允许我们向您致谢和道歉……

say:21:1322134012:1.text: The goddess encourages us to be kind and considerate. I understand your fear, so I hold no grudges. However, there's something I hope you can assist me with.
say:21:1322134012:1.source_cn: 女神教导我们要懂得体谅他人，我明白你们的恐惧，所以我不...

say:22:1322134013:1.text: The Graveborn need our help? What's the problem?
say:22:1322134013:1.source_cn: 亡灵需要我们帮助？是什么事情？

choice_prompt:23:1322134013.text: The Graveborn need our help? What's the problem?
choice_prompt:23:1322134013.source_cn: 亡灵需要我们帮助？是什么事情？

say:24:1322134014:1.text: This matter requires our cooperation. If successful, the undead will no longer be a threat to the people of Whiteridge.
say:24:1322134014:1.source_cn: 这件事需要我们合作。如果成功了，活死人就不会再成为白山...

say:25:1322134015:1.text: The undead were once soldiers in the First Divine War, and they were heroes of Whiteridge. I hope we can purify them in the Divine Light and have them rest in peace in the tranquil kingdom of the goddess.
say:25:1322134015:1.source_cn: 那些活死人，他们曾是第一次神魔战争时的士兵，是白山的英...

say:26:1322134016:1.text: I'm deeply moved by what you've said. But you know we lack the strength to confront the undead... May Dura bless you.
say:26:1322134016:1.source_cn: 我承认我被你打动了。可你们很清楚，我们的力量太弱，根本...

say:28:1322134017:1.text: I-I need to be honest. Even though I'm thankful you saved me, I can't bring myself to cooperate with the Graveborn just yet. I'm sorry... I'll pray for the goddess to bless you.
say:28:1322134017:1.source_cn: 我……我必须说实话，虽然很感激你们的救命之恩，但我目前...

say:29:1322134018:1.text: Lady Carolina... If I help, can you... can you guarantee my safety?
say:29:1322134018:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜女士，如果我帮助你们的话，你……你能保证我的安全吗？

say:30:1322134019:1.text: I swear to the goddess, your safety will always come first.
say:30:1322134019:1.source_cn: 我向女神发誓，你们的安全是第一位的。

say:31:1322134020:1.text: Then my answer is yes, I'm willing to cooperate.
say:31:1322134020:1.source_cn: 好！那么……我愿意配合你们。

say:33:1322134021:1.text: And me, as well! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved my life. I'm willing to put my life on the line to repay my debt.
say:33:1322134021:1.male: And me, as well! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved my life. I'm willing to put my life on the line to repay my debt.
say:33:1322134021:1.female: And me, as well! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> saved my life. I'm willing to put my life on the line to repay my debt.

say:34:1322134022:1.text: Furthermore, if we can fully purify the undead, I'll brave any danger. This is my duty as an acolyte of the goddess!
say:34:1322134022:1.source_cn: 更何况，如果真能够彻底净化活死人，哪怕有再大的危险我都...

say:35:1322134023:1.text: Acolyte Maxim, Acolyte Ogden... Thank you. Dura will surely bless and protect you.
say:35:1322134023:1.source_cn: 马克西姆修士，奥格列修士……谢谢你们，愿艾雅保佑你们。

say:36:1322134024:1.text: This matter requires Valka's assistance. She's likely around Sorrowfall Lake. We need to ask her if she's discovered a way to awaken the undead's sanity.
say:36:1322134024:1.source_cn: 这件事还需要瓦丽卡姐姐的帮助才行，她应该在哀叹之湖，我...

say:37:1322134025:1.text: Valka? Is she also a Graveborn?

say:39:1322134026:1.text: She's a mighty and kind Graveborn, the savior of Whiteridge! She's the one who took down the Frost Furie and ended the crisis. Well, Chippy did pitch in a little too.
say:39:1322134026:1.source_cn: 她是一位强大的、善良的亡灵，是白山的英雄！就是她战胜了...

say:40:1322134027:1.text: Dura above, I thought I knew Whiteridge inside and out, but you all keep shattering my understanding over and over... Once this is done, I need to dive deep into the history of the duchy.
say:40:1322134027:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我以为我已经很了解白山了，结果你们一次又一次...

say:42:1322134028:1.text: Please follow me. Let us find Valka.
say:42:1322134028:1.source_cn: 请跟我来吧，我们现在就去找瓦丽卡姐姐。

choice:23:0:1.text: A plan on how to purify the undead...
choice:23:0:1.source_cn: （讲述彻底净化活死人的计划）
choice:23:0:1.male: A plan on how to purify the undead...
choice:23:0:1.female: A plan on how to purify the undead...

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 并非所有亡灵都是圣堂的敌人

choice:12:1:2.text: We only need to be wary of the crazy undead.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 该警惕的是失去理智的活死人
choice:12:1:2.male: We only need to be wary of the crazy undead.
choice:12:1:2.female: We only need to be wary of the crazy undead.
